info.name: AKF Tender and Supplier Management — S1–S7 API
info.description:
S1 implemented operations, derived from Swagger and API_CONTRACT.md. Cookie authentication; leave the Postman cookie jar enabled. Set baseUrl, language (en/ar), email, and password locally. Never export live credentials, tokens, cookies, or signed paths. Request folders match the README Backend API Overview.

Use requests individually; do not run every folder blindly: writes change state. Recommended path: A1 as employee → Q1/Q3/Q4 → A4 → change email/password to officer → A1 → M2/M3 → M5 (select a file)/M10/M11 → M2 → set future ISO UTC deadlines → M8 → T1/T2/T2d. Set tenderId explicitly when choosing an existing or cancelled seeded tender. M6 deletes files and M9 copies only a cancelled tender. Fetch M2 or M10 before changes; revision updates are chained from successful responses. Standard bid inputs are fixed. Auth refresh/sign-out rotate or revoke cookies. All examples are illustrative, not captured production data.

Collection generation: current NestJS Swagger is the endpoint/DTO source; examples and scripts implement the accepted contract. Extend this collection in later slices.

S2 sign-up: R2, U1–U7 including U3d, and account setup S1–S3. Supplier profile P1–P2 and the admin directory P4–P5 are included; certificate replacement and download (P3, P3d) are included; technical documents are not implemented yet. Start signed out for U1, then use the legal and admin demo accounts. U7 emails a setup link; read it in Mailpit (http://localhost:8025) and copy the token after #token= into setupToken locally. Never save a live setupToken or newPassword in the collection. Retain applicationKey for a retry; clear it only for a deliberately new/changed action. The guest cookie scope survives CSRF renewal.

exec: // Web writes use CSRF. Mobile auth uses explicit credentials only.
const response = await pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/v1/auth/csrf", method: "GET", header: { "Accept-Language": pm.variables.get("language") } });
if (response.code !== 200) throw new Error("Cannot obtain CSRF token");

request.description: Sign in as an administrator and fetch a session CSRF token first. Creates a pending employee account and queues a setup email.
Reports API and database health.

item.name: A0 CSRF token and server time

request.description: Returns a CSRF token and serverTime; never cache. Collection prerequest obtains a fresh token before each write. Do not export live tokens.

originalRequest.description: Returns a CSRF token and serverTime; never cache. Collection prerequest obtains a fresh token before each write. Do not export live tokens.

request.description: Set email and password locally (see README demo accounts). Cookie jar stores HttpOnly session and refresh cookies. No bearer header. A fresh session-bound CSRF token is fetched before the next write.
Current session, private and never cached. SESSION_EXPIRED requires A3; SESSION_REVOKED requires sign-in.
Uses refresh cookies, rotates tokens, and returns 204. Obtain a new CSRF token after refresh; collection prerequest does this before every write.
Returns 204 and clears session cookies. The session is immediately revoked.
Signed in only. Updates preferredLanguage to en or ar.
Employee only. Creates a draft; saves its ID and revision for subsequent requests.

originalRequest.description: Employee only. Creates a draft; saves its ID and revision for subsequent requests.

request.description: Employee only; returns only their own tenders, newest first. Optional page and limit query parameters.
Employee only. Fetch before editing; updates revision. Invisible records return 404.
Employee only, draft only. A stale revision returns VERSION_CONFLICT; acceptance returns TENDER_STATUS_CHANGED.

originalRequest.description: Employee only, draft only. A stale revision returns VERSION_CONFLICT; acceptance returns TENDER_STATUS_CHANGED.
Employee only, draft only. A stale revision returns VERSION_CONFLICT; acceptance returns TENDER_STATUS_CHANGED.

request.description: Employee only, own tender. Returns a private, short-lived signed path; other employees receive 404.
Officer only. Enable status to filter. Optional page and limit.
Officer only. Fetch immediately before each change; saves revision, category and first original document ID.
Officer only, accepted only. Sends the reviewed revision. One complete language is required; a second is optional.

originalRequest.description: Officer only, accepted only. Sends the reviewed revision. One complete language is required; a second is optional.
Officer only, accepted only. Sends the reviewed revision. One complete language is required; a second is optional.

request.description: Officer only, draft only. Weights total 100; all scoring values are integers from 0 to 100.

originalRequest.description: Officer only, draft only. Weights total 100; all scoring values are integers from 0 to 100.
Officer only, draft only. Weights total 100; all scoring values are integers from 0 to 100.

request.description: Officer only, accepted only. Select a local file in form-data. Enable translationOf only for a translated copy in a different language. An original of the same kind must be removed before replacement. Choose language en or ar.

item.name: M6 Remove document and its translations

request.description: Officer only, accepted only. Destructive: deleting an original deletes all translations. Fetch M2 first and check docId and revision.

originalRequest.description: Officer only, accepted only. Destructive: deleting an original deletes all translations. Fetch M2 first and check docId and revision.

request.description: Officer only. Returns a private, short-lived signed path. Follow the path exactly; do not construct it.
Officer only, accepted only. Future deadlines must be strictly ordered. This locks content, scoring, deadlines, documents and the bid form.

originalRequest.description: Officer only, accepted only. Future deadlines must be strictly ordered. This locks content, scoring, deadlines, documents and the bid form.

request.description: Officer only. Set tenderId to a cancelled source. Copying is allowed once. The accepted copy has no deadlines or bids. To inspect the result, run M2. A second copy returns TENDER_ALREADY_COPIED.

originalRequest.description: Officer only. Set tenderId to a cancelled source. Copying is allowed once. The accepted copy has no deadlines or bids. To inspect the result, run M2. A second copy returns TENDER_ALREADY_COPIED.

request.description: Officer only, from acceptance. Standard fields/documents are immutable. Saves current revision.

Officer only, accepted only. Replaces the full ordered custom template in all three parts. For existing fields retain fieldId from M10; omit it only for new fields. This sample replaces existing custom fields. Types: text, number, boolean, file. Unit/minimum are numeric-only. Publication locks it.

originalRequest.description: Officer only, accepted only. Replaces the full ordered custom template in all three parts. For existing fields retain fieldId from M10; omit it only for new fields. item.name: Mobile Auth (S7)
item.description: Run MA1 as a supplier, use the access token for the read requests, and use the latest refresh token for MA2 or MA3. Set token variables only in your local environment.

request.description: Use an active supplier. Set credentials locally. The response contains a device token pair; never save live values in the collection.
Paste the current device refresh token into a local environment. Replace it with the returned token after each successful refresh.

item.name: MA3 Sign out of the mobile session

request.description: Revokes the mobile device session. Clear local token variables after use.
Returns the signed-in supplier’s paginated bid summaries.
Returns only the tender status, part deadlines, and locked state for a bid owned by the supplier.
Anyone. Published only; no balance or scoring. Optional category, page and limit. Language fallback follows Accept-Language.

exec: pm.test("Public view contains no balance or scoring", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(data)).not.to.match(/estimatedBalance|scoring|requestedBy/));

request.description: Anyone. Published only; all other statuses are 404. No balance or scoring.

exec: pm.test("Public view contains no balance or scoring", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(data)).not.to.match(/estimatedBalance|scoring|requestedBy/));

request.description: Anyone; published tender only. Returns a short-lived signed path, not the file bytes. Follow it through the Files request.
Anyone. Paginated category codes.
Anyone. Fixed required legal fields and certificate requirements; publicly cacheable.

Guest only: sign out first. Select both local files. applicationKey is generated once and retained for retries; clear it for a deliberately changed application. A replay returns the original 201 body with Idempotent-Replayed. Invalid same-key payload returns 422; in-progress returns 409 (retry after one second). A registered supplier number returns REGISTRATION_NUMBER_EXISTS. No account or email is created by this endpoint.
Standing legal_committee role only. Oldest pending first; paginated. Only pending is a supported status.
Standing legal_committee role only. Application fields and original document metadata. No storage keys or other audience data.
Standing legal_committee role only. The document must belong to this application. Returns an expiring signed URL; use the Files request to follow it.

Standing legal_committee role only. accepted raises the request to admin; rejected ends sign-up. Repeated review returns 409 ALREADY_SUBMITTED with details.decision. Concurrent reviews store only one decision.

originalRequest.description: Standing legal_committee role only. accepted raises the request to admin; rejected ends sign-up. Repeated review returns 409 ALREADY_SUBMITTED with details.decision. Concurrent reviews store only one decision.

request.description: Admin only. Oldest raised, not-yet-admin-accepted requests first, paginated.
Admin only, legally accepted/raised applications only. Read-only application fields and accepted review; no application document-download permission. U7 is not implemented in this task.

Admin only, no body. Creates the supplier, its pending_setup account and first setup link in one transaction, then emails the link in the applicant's language. Provisions at most once: 409 ALREADY_ACCEPTED (details.supplierId), then 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED, then 409 REGISTRATION_NUMBER_EXISTS (the request stays raised).

originalRequest.description: Admin only, no body. Creates the supplier, its pending_setup account and first setup link in one transaction, then emails the link in the applicant's language. Provisions at most once: 409 ALREADY_ACCEPTED (details.supplierId), then 409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED, then 409 REGISTRATION_NUMBER_EXISTS (the request stays raised).

request.description: Public; the token from the emailed link's #token= fragment. Checks the link without using it up. 404 invalid, 410 SETUP_LINK_EXPIRED or SETUP_LINK_USED. Rate limited per IP.

originalRequest.description: Public; the token from the emailed link's #token= fragment. Checks the link without using it up. 404 invalid, 410 SETUP_LINK_EXPIRED or SETUP_LINK_USED. Rate limited per IP.

request.description: Public. Uses the link up, activates the account, verifies the email and signs in (session cookies). Returns the session body plus next: supplier_profile or my_assignments. Fetch a new CSRF token afterwards (A0). A password needs at least 12 characters: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK.

originalRequest.description: Public. Uses the link up, activates the account, verifies the email and signs in (session cookies). Returns the session body plus next: supplier_profile or my_assignments. Fetch a new CSRF token afterwards (A0). A password needs at least 12 characters: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK.

request.description: Public. Always 202. Emails a new link only for an expired, unused link of an account still pending setup, at most 5 links an hour per account.
Supplier only. Legal and technical information, status and editableFields. technicalDocuments stays empty until P3.

item.name: P2 Edit legal and technical information

request.description: Supplier only, also while suspended. Any of legalName, registrationNumber, technicalInformation; any other field is 400 FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE. 409 REGISTRATION_NUMBER_EXISTS. Legal changes are audited with values before and after.

Supplier only. Multipart kind (registration_certificate or tax_certificate), language and file (select a local file). Replaces the current certificate of that kind; the reviewed sign-up file stays on the application. Returns 201 with the profile.
Supplier only. Signed link for a file listed in certificates; any other ID is 404. Follow it with the Files request.
Admin only. Paginated, by legal name. Filter by status; search matches legal name or registration number. allowedActions is suspend or reactivate.
Admin only. Blocks new bids only; the supplier still signs in. Repeating returns the same result.
Admin only. Repeating returns the same result.
procurement_officer. Committees and nominations, paginated.
procurement_officer; tender accepted, published or closed. 201, or 200 when already raised.
procurement_officer; the committee is raised. Use a fictional address.
procurement_officer, while nominated. 409 ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_DECIDED otherwise.
admin. Waiting nominations, oldest first.
admin. preferredLanguage is required only when no account exists; then an account and a setup email are created. 409 ASSIGNMENT_* or TENDER_STATUS_CHANGED.
admin. 409 ASSIGNMENT_ALREADY_DECIDED when already decided.
Any signed-in user. Approved assignments; stage is waiting until bids exist.
Supplier only. Standard and custom fields per part; canSubmit with reasonCode.

Active supplier, published tender, before the application deadline. Set bidKey to a new UUID per deliberate submission and reuse it on retries. Select the three files locally. Add custom answers under bid.answers keyed by part and field ID; custom file fields use files[part][fieldId].
Supplier only. Tender status only, never won or not won.
Supplier only, own bid. No bidder code, evaluations or other bids.

exec: const doc = data.parts[0] && data.parts[0].documents[0]; if (doc) pm.variables.set("docId", doc.id);

request.description: Supplier only, before the technical deadline; allowed while suspended. Sends the whole part; every previous file is replaced. 422 BID_PART_LOCKED after the deadline. Use a new bidKey.
Supplier only, own file. Follow it with the Files request.
Approved legal_committee assignment on this tender. 409 TENDER_STATUS_CHANGED before under_evaluation.
Supplier identity, legal information and documents only.
While under_evaluation. A fail needs a reason. Repeat: 409 ALREADY_SUBMITTED.
Signed link; follow it with the Files request.
Approved technical_committee assignment; bids that passed Legal only, by bidder code.
No bid ID, supplier identity or original file names.
Whole number 0–100, one shared score per bid.
Neutral download name.
Approved financial_committee assignment; bids that met the minimum technical score only.
Financial offer and tender currency only.
Score 0–100 and the confirmed total price as a decimal string.
Neutral download name.
procurement_officer. Always answers: progress, award and tie candidates.
Names and scores only; ties share a rank.
While tie_break_required. Set actionKey to a new UUID.
kind=award covers the winner's and the other bidders' emails.
Preview with lang and dir.
While draft or failed, at the reviewed revision.
202 when this call starts the delivery; 200 when already sending or sent.
List each email at its reviewed revision.

Use the exact path returned by Q5, M7 or T2d, valid for five minutes. In a collection run it is transiently chained; for an individual Send paste the returned path into a local signedDownloadPath value. Never export it. No file key or signature is constructed by the client.
